g.title: commons — drives the public — open information a community reads and adds to: maps, records, public data
core — drives the corpus and its tooling — governance, the archive, the deltas, the maps, the language data
games — drives play — a game somebody plays: its rules, its world, its loop, and the server it is played on
infra — drives where a thing runs, and how it is reached — ingress, identity, storage, DNS, observability, the network path
instruments — drives the sound — looping, synthesis, tempo, remote control surfaces
irl — drives matter — a thing somebody builds, holds or installs: parts, boards, enclosures, and the firmware that makes one work
performer-display — drives the performer — what a player reads while playing
performing — drives a show — what an audience sees and hears, and the video made before and after it
show-control — drives the room — cues, lighting, sound and video playback, audio transport
uPhonor — n/a · not adopted · also in instruments, irl
stomp — n/a · not adopted · also in instruments, irl
ira — n/a · not adopted · also in irl, show-control
